ModMetaData.name: Shift Change
ModMetaData.author: MrBeverage
ModMetaData.description:
Pawns change into the right clothes for the room they work in, and back out again afterwards.
Assign an outfit stand to a colonist and stand it in a work room. When that colonist takes on automatic work of the room's kind — doctoring in the hospital, researching in the laboratory — they change into whatever the stand holds before they start, and change back when they leave.
Deliberately narrow: - Automatic work only. Ordering a doctor to tend someone right now never sends them across the base to change first. - One stand, one owner. Their uniform is their own, and nobody walks off in someone else's clothes. - Never during a raid or other threat.
Adds no clothing of its own. It uses the vanilla outfit stand and whatever apparel you put on it.
Requires Odyssey (for the outfit stand) and Harmony.
